name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager · Technical Onboarding, Integrations & Enterprise Accounts
summary: Customer success and account management professional with 15+ years in SaaS and B2B environments, owning the post-sale relationship for high-value account portfolios and driving adoption, retention, and growth. Hands-on with API integrations, CRM architecture, and technical onboarding, guiding clients and internal teams through system configuration and troubleshooting rather than just describing it. Has led onboarding, training, and escalation management across enterprise and mid-market accounts, and has partnered directly with Product and Engineering to turn customer feedback into roadmap input.
